name: Algolia
desc: Manage your Algolia search indices — add, browse, and delete records.

actions.name: save-records
actions.description: Adds or updates records in an Algolia index.

actions.name: browse-records
actions.description: Retrieves records from an Algolia index.

actions.name: delete-records
actions.description: Deletes records from an Algolia index by objectID.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
